name: Redemption
text: [overview] P1 (WI4+, 60m): a snow gully of steep angle runs upward and rightward for 30 meters, ending at a steep pillar;
[overview] P2 (WI4+ M4, 30m): continue up the gully, snow then steepening ice, and belay from screws inside a cave under a thin, vertical pillar.
[overview] P3 (WI5+ M4, 55m): use an ice mushroom as a step onto the pillar, and climb it and/or stem up the slim chimney, some 25 meters, until a snow gully appears;

name: After Eight
text: [overview] Then a very easy gully (WI1, 45m) of mixed snow, ice and stone.
